title.zh: 【以太坊主网完成首笔 L1 至 L2 原子跨链交易，原子同步可组合性实现落地】
title.en: 【以太坊主网完成首笔 L1 至 L2 原子跨链交易，原子同步可组合性实现落地】

current_state.zh: Ethereum mainnet executed its first atomic L1-to-L2 cross-chain transaction, marking the first mainnet implementation of atomic synchronous composability according to Ethereum Economic Zone contributor Eduardo Antuña.
current_state.en: Ethereum mainnet executed its first atomic L1-to-L2 cross-chain transaction, marking the first mainnet implementation of atomic synchronous composability according to Ethereum Economic Zone contributor Eduardo Antuña.
